nodes.summary: Let $f : X \to Y$ be a function on a finite nonempty set $X$, let $\ell \ge 1$ be the message length, and let $A$ be a one-time forger whose random coins range over a finite nonempty set $R$. Then the probability that $A$ wins the one-time forgery game against the Lamport scheme built from $f$ is at most $2\ell$ times the probability that the inverter built from $A$ wins the one-wayness game for $f$.

nodes.summary: Let $f : X \to Y$. Given a secret key $sk : \{0, \dots, \ell - 1\} \times \{0, 1\} \to X$, a position $(i, b)$ and a value $y \in Y$, the planted public key takes the value $y$ at $(i, b)$ and the value $f(sk(j, c))$ at every other position $(j, c)$.
nodes.title: Planted public key

nodes.summary: For a function $f : X \to Y$ and a secret key $sk : \{0, \dots, \ell - 1\} \times \{0, 1\} \to X$, the public key is the map $pk : \{0, \dots, \ell - 1\} \times \{0, 1\} \to Y$ with $pk(i, b) = f(sk(i, b))$.
nodes.title: Lamport public key

nodes.summary: The signature of a message $m \in \{0, 1\}^\ell$ under a secret key $sk : \{0, \dots, \ell - 1\} \times \{0, 1\} \to X$ is $\sigma \in X^\ell$ with $\sigma_i = sk(i, m_i)$ for every position $i < \ell$.
nodes.title: Lamport signing

nodes.summary: Let $f : X \to Y$. For every secret key $sk : \{0, \dots, \ell - 1\} \times \{0, 1\} \to X$ and every message $m \in \{0, 1\}^\ell$, the Lamport signature of $m$ under $sk$ is valid for $m$ under the public key of $sk$.
nodes.title: Correctness of Lamport signatures

nodes.summary: Let $f : X \to Y$. A signature $\sigma \in X^\ell$ on a message $m \in \{0, 1\}^\ell$ is valid for a public key $pk : \{0, \dots, \ell - 1\} \times \{0, 1\} \to Y$ when $f(\sigma_i) = pk(i, m_i)$ for every position $i < \ell$.

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
